column2: Your notes are just files. Acme Notes keeps every note as plain markdown in a folder you choose, so grep, git and backups all work on day one.
Type [[ and a note title to link two notes. Rename the note later and every link follows it.

How do you organise notes: one big folder, a folder per project, or tags only?
